pkgmetadata.longdescription: OpenAI Whisper speech recognition models in the CTranslate2 format that faster-whisper loads, pinned to upstream revisions and installed under /usr/share/faster-whisper/NAME. Gabbee's offline dictation looks models up there by name, so dictation keeps working with no network and downloads nothing at run time.

use.flag: Install distil-small.en, the English default: accurate and fast enough on a CPU for push-to-talk
Install base.en, faster and less accurate, for slow CPUs
Install the multilingual large-v3-turbo (1.6 GB); too slow for dictation without a GPU
